name: Open Code Review
cost: Free (Apache-2.0). You pay your LLM provider for the model calls unless you use delegation mode.
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code and OpenCode, on Windows, macOS and Linux
short: A code review CLI from Alibaba that reads your Git diff and leaves line-level review comments using an LLM you configure.
what: Open Code Review started as Alibaba's internal AI code review assistant. The `ocr` command reads your Git changes, sends the changed files to an LLM agent that can read whole files and search the codebase, and writes structured comments tied to exact lines. Fixed engineering steps pick and group the files and match review rules, and the agent handles the judgement calls. `ocr scan` reviews whole files when there's no diff.
who: Developers and teams who want automated reviews on their own changes or in CI. The README says it trades some recall for precision, so it finds fewer issues than a general agent but raises fewer false alarms. If you already review by hand and don't want an LLM in the loop, skip it.
needs: Node and npm for the global install
An LLM provider and API key, unless you use delegation mode

steps.title: Install the CLI
steps.text: This puts the `ocr` command on your path. The docs list other ways to install, such as an install script or a release binary.

steps.title: Pick a provider and model
steps.text: An interactive screen asks for the provider, your API key and the model, then tests the connection.
steps.code:
ocr config provider          # Select a built-in provider or add a custom one
ocr config model             # Pick a model for the active provider

steps.title: Review your changes
steps.text: Run it inside your project. This reviews staged, unstaged and untracked changes.

steps.title: Or let your coding agent do the review
steps.text: Delegation mode has OCR choose the files and rules while your agent's own model writes the review, so no OCR API key is needed.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `ocr scan --path internal/agent` to review a whole directory, or `ocr review --format json --output result.json` to save the results for an AI agent to read.

watch: Your changed files and parts of your codebase go to whatever LLM provider you configure.
The setup stores your provider API key.
Plugins for each coding agent are documented separately in `plugins/open-code-review/README.md`.
